card.name: Words just before a noun in names or trial counts
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered words that precede a noun, such as a number before 'clinical trials', a capitalised word before 'Lab' or 'Center', or a digit inside a patient count.

modes.label: Numbers in trial counts
modes.description: Digits or number words inside patient or trial counts in label text.

modes.label: Words inside organisation or study names
modes.description: A capitalised word within an institute, centre or study name.
modes.example: set up a<< Business>> Center in India and the U.K.

card.plain: It fires on unrelated words that sit just before a noun, in names or patient counts, so no clear pattern emerges.
